nodes.label: Wakeel.org Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Pakistan-focused AI legal assistant brand positioned for mobile-first market across Android, iOS and web. Tagline: 'Pakistan's AI Legal Assistant — in your pocket'.

nodes.label: Design System Color System (HSL CSS Variables)
nodes.rationale: HSL CSS variables used for light/dark theme switching, with brand color #3b82f6 (blue) for PWA manifest. Enables consistent theming via Tailwind CSS.
nodes.norm_label: design system color system (hsl css variables)

nodes.label: Theme Context Pattern (Dark/Light Mode)
nodes.rationale: ThemeContext wraps app, useTheme() hook toggles dark class on document.documentElement, persists in localStorage, respects prefers-color-scheme.

nodes.label: detectPlatform() Utility
nodes.rationale: Detects iOS/Android/Web to redirect users to TestFlight, Play Store, or web app respectively. Centralizes all store URLs in APP_STORE_LINKS constant.

nodes.label: Firebase Hosting Deployment (asia-east1)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 14 static export deployed to Firebase Hosting with Firebase Firestore backend. Region asia-east1 chosen for Pakistan/Asia proximity.

nodes.label: Beta Features (Commented-Out, Preserved)
nodes.rationale: BetaLaunchPopup and BetaWhitelistSection preserved but commented out for potential re-enablement in future beta campaigns. beta_whitelist Firestore collection retained.

nodes.label: Progressive Web App (PWA) Support
nodes.rationale: PWA manifest enables installable standalone app experience on mobile. Theme color #3b82f6. Shortcuts: Get Started, Contact Us, Journal.

nodes.label: Geographic Meta Tags (GEO Targeting)
nodes.rationale: geo.region PK-PB, geo.placename Lahore, coordinates 31.5204/74.3587 for local SEO in Pakistan. Service area 20,000km radius via Schema.org GeoCircle.

nodes.label: AI Crawler Allowlist in robots.txt
nodes.rationale: Explicitly allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, CCBot, anthropic-ai, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot to index the site for AI search engine visibility alongside traditional crawlers.

nodes.label: 27 Pakistan Legal Guides
nodes.rationale: 27 comprehensive legal guides covering all major Pakistani legal categories created for Pakistan SEO. Auto-generated keywords from guide content via GuidePage component.

nodes.rationale: Added keywords, region, language params with hreflang for en-PK/ur-PK variants. Centralizes SEO metadata generation across guide pages.

nodes.label: 20 GCC Legal Guides
nodes.rationale: 20 guides for Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman covering kafala system, Sharia law, migrant worker rights, expat resources, and country-specific procedures.

nodes.label: 24 Global Legal Guides (15+ Countries)
nodes.rationale: 24 guides covering common law (UK/US/Canada/Australia/India/Singapore/HK), civil law (Germany/France/Netherlands/Spain/Brazil/Mexico), Islamic/mixed systems, international employment/business law, expat guide.

nodes.label: Subscription Tier Model (Free/Student/Professional/Organization)
nodes.rationale: 4-tier PKR pricing: Free (PKR 0), Student (PKR 199/mo), Professional (PKR 4,999/mo), Organization (PKR 9,999+). Role-based access tied to subscription status with 7-day grace period.

nodes.label: Role-Specific Data Collection & Privacy Policy
nodes.rationale: Tier-specific data collection: Students get FERPA compliance/no marketing; Professionals get attorney-work-product confidentiality; Organizations get DPA/GDPR support. AES-256 encryption across all tiers.

nodes.label: Firestore Database Collections
nodes.rationale: Collections: team_members, company_timeline, website_faqs, website_queries, subscribed_users (with email_sent tracking), web_sales_query, blog_posts, beta_whitelist.

nodes.label: Wakeel AI Legal Assistant Service
nodes.rationale: AI-powered legal assistant for Pakistan/GCC/global legal systems. Supports English and Urdu. Provides legal information and research support — explicitly not a substitute for a licensed advocate.
